name: website-asset-capture
description: STRATELOQ-WEBSITE-ASSET-CAPTURE-001 — reusable headless-browser capture of real public Pulse pages into media_assets + Brand Asset Lock (UI_SCREENSHOT, PENDING). Public routes only.
notes: Chromium + playwright are provided by the runtime (PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH, global playwright). If running elsewhere: npm i playwright && npx playwright install chromium.
